title: Suspicious Process Execution Detected via Defend for Containers
author: Elastic
description:
This rule detects the execution of a process from a suspicious directory inside a container.
The suspicious directories are /tmp, /dev/shm, /var/tmp, /run, /var/run, /mnt, /media, and /boot.
Adversaries may use these directories to execute malicious code or exfiltrate data.
